title: metadata.rs five-step doc-comment is mis-numbered 1-6 for 'five-step pattern'
description: src/methods/metadata.rs:3 module docstring opens with 'Each method follows the standard five-step pattern:' then enumerates SIX steps (1. Validate, 2. session_parts, 3. Build args JSON, 4. build_request, 5. call_internal, 6. extract_response). Cookie-cut verbatim from canonical mail-client which has the same mistake. Audience: contributor learning the pattern. Fix: either change 'five-step' to 'six-step' or fold step 5 (call_internal) and step 6 (extract_response) into a single 'POST + extract' bullet — the latter matches the README's own 'five-step pattern' phrasing (README §How it works lists 5 bullets). This is a canonical-template change; the README count is correct; the inline comment should match.
